headline: Marban Hollow Turns to Wardens; Olavis Wake Wholly Colonial
war_summary: Ground has changed hands on three fronts since the noon edition. Marban Hollow, which stood one Warden work to five Colonial three hours ago, now reads four Wardens, three Colonials and one unclaimed; seven actions are reported in the past two hours and thirty across the day, chiefly about Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall. Olavis Wake has gone entirely Colonial, five works with none in dispute, after five actions in two hours and sixteen in six; the day's toll there is set at 4,629 Colonial and 4,583 Warden. Weathered Expanse now shows five Colonial works, one Warden and three unclaimed, with four actions in two hours, sixteen in six and fifty-five across the day, its cost the heaviest on the board at 7,647 Colonial and 9,058 Warden. Kuura Strand, quiet at midday, has stirred again with two actions in two hours and holds three Warden works, two Colonial and one unclaimed. Farranac Coast reports no base change in twenty-four hours but the sharpest casualty rate anywhere, above three hundred Colonial and four hundred Warden an hour and still rising. Callahan's Passage and Dead Lands remain costly but static; the Nevish Line has gone quiet.
